definitions: Used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously.
Used to add a comment that is in some way opposed to what has just been said.
Used to introduce a statement that provides a different perspective or qualification to a previous statement.
examples: It was a difficult climb; however, we made it to the summit.
I like the colour; however, it doesn't suit me.
The project was challenging; however, the team worked well together.
